jobs.title: Vice President of Product Management
jobs.description:
Company Description
The Volkswagen Group, headquartered in Wolfsburg, Germany, is one of the world’s leading automotive companies and Europe’s largest carmaker, with ten well-known brands including Volkswagen, Audi, Škoda, SEAT, CUPRA, Porsche, Bentley, Lamborghini, and Ducati. With around 663,000 employees and 111 production facilities worldwide, the Group’s vehicles and services reach customers in more than 150 countries. Volkswagen is focused on shaping the future of mobility through connected, intelligent vehicle technologies and innovative digital solutions. The Group is strongly committed to decarbonization, resource efficiency, and making advanced automotive technologies broadly accessible. More information on legal and data topics can be found at the company’s official online resources.
Role Description
The Vice President of Product Management is a full-time remote role responsible for leading the product vision, strategy, and roadmap across a portfolio of mobility and digital solutions. This role oversees end-to-end product lifecycle management, from market discovery and requirements definition to launch, iteration, and retirement, ensuring alignment with the company’s global mobility and sustainability objectives. Day-to-day responsibilities include collaborating with engineering, design, marketing, sales, and operations to prioritize features, optimize customer value, and drive commercial performance. The Vice President leads and mentors product management teams, establishes best practices, and uses data-driven insights to guide decisions and refine product strategies. This role also engages with senior leadership and external partners to identify new opportunities, manage key initiatives, and ensure product offerings remain competitive and innovative in the global market.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Product Strategy and Product Management skills to define vision, build roadmaps, and manage the full product lifecycle.
Candidates should possess advanced Analytical Skills to interpret market data, customer insights, and performance metrics to support data-driven decisions.
Candidates should possess proven Team Leadership capabilities to build, mentor, and guide diverse product teams in a collaborative environment.
Candidates should possess solid Project Management skills to oversee complex, cross-functional initiatives and deliver outcomes on time and within scope.
Extensive experience in senior product leadership roles, preferably in automotive, mobility, or technology sectors.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills across global, cross-cultural teams.
Experience with agile methodologies, digital product development, and customer-centric design practices.
Advanced degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.description:
Vice President, Product

Location: United States | Full-Time | Remote / Hybrid / On-site
Reports To: Chief Executive Officer

About the Role

We are looking for a Vice President, Product to lead the organization’s product strategy, product development, and long-term product direction.

This is a senior leadership role responsible for defining product vision, developing product roadmaps, prioritizing initiatives, improving customer experiences, and ensuring that products deliver meaningful business and customer value.

You will work closely with executive leadership and partner across Technology, Engineering, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Customer Service, Customer Success, Marketing, and Business Development. The role will have significant influence over product strategy, product architecture priorities, roadmap planning, user experience, product performance, and the overall product development process.

The ideal candidate combines strong product leadership with commercial judgment, customer insight, analytical thinking, and the ability to translate business objectives and market opportunities into scalable products.

Responsibilities

• Lead the overall Product function and establish a clear product vision and strategy aligned with company objectives.

• Develop and maintain a comprehensive product roadmap covering near-term priorities and long-term strategic initiatives.

• Translate customer needs, market trends, business requirements, competitive intelligence, and organizational priorities into product strategies and initiatives.

• Establish product prioritization frameworks and make informed decisions regarding product investments, resources, timelines, and strategic trade-offs.

• Lead the product lifecycle from discovery and requirements definition through development, launch, optimization, and continuous improvement.

• Work closely with Engineering and Technology teams to define product requirements, specifications, priorities, and delivery expectations.

• Partner with Operations, Customer Service, and Customer Success teams to identify recurring customer needs and operational opportunities that can be addressed through product improvements.

• Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure product development incorporates appropriate regulatory, risk, governance, and control requirements.

• Develop product requirements, business cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, and other documentation necessary to support effective product development.

• Establish product performance metrics and monitor adoption, engagement, retention, conversion, usage, customer satisfaction, and other relevant indicators.

• Conduct regular product reviews and use data, customer feedback, and market intelligence to identify opportunities for product improvement.

• Lead product discovery, user research, customer interviews, competitive analysis, and market research to validate product opportunities.

• Oversee product launches and coordinate cross-functional launch planning across Product, Technology, Operations, Marketing, Sales, Customer Service, and other relevant teams.

• Establish processes for product experimentation, testing, feedback collection, iteration, and continuous improvement.

• Evaluate new technologies, market developments, partnerships, and emerging opportunities that may influence the organization’s product strategy.

• Develop product governance, decision-making standards, documentation practices, and product management processes that can scale with the organization.

• Partner with Marketing and Business Development teams to develop product positioning, go-to-market strategies, customer messaging, and commercial launch plans.

• Monitor competitor products, market developments, customer expectations, and industry trends to identify potential opportunities and risks.

• Manage product budgets, resources, priorities, and team capacity to ensure effective execution of the product roadmap.

• Establish executive-level product dashboards, KPIs, reporting, and strategic reviews for senior leadership.

• Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Product organization, including product managers, product operations, product strategy, and related functions.

• Establish a strong product culture focused on customer value, disciplined prioritization, measurable outcomes, innovation, and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a senior product leader who can combine strategic thinking with strong execution and build products that meet customer needs while supporting broader business objectives.

The strongest candidates will typically have:

• 20+ years of progressive experience in product management, product strategy, product development, product operations, or a related field.

• Significant senior leadership experience as a VP of Product, Head of Product, Chief Product Officer, Group Product Manager, or equivalent product leadership role.

• Demonstrated experience developing product strategies, roadmaps, product organizations, and scalable product management processes.

• Strong understanding of the complete product lifecycle, including discovery, research, requirements, development, launch, adoption, measurement, and optimization.

• Proven experience managing complex products, platforms, or technology-enabled services with multiple stakeholders and customer segments.

• Strong ability to translate customer needs, market opportunities, and business objectives into clear product priorities and requirements.

• Experience working closely with Engineering, Technology, Operations, Design, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Risk, Compliance, and executive leadership.

• Strong analytical skills and experience using product metrics, customer data, market research, and business performance data to guide product decisions.

• Demonstrated experience leading product launches, major product initiatives, platform improvements, and cross-functional transformation programs.

• Strong understanding of user experience, product usability, customer journeys, experimentation, and product performance measurement.

• Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong commercial judgment and understanding of how product decisions influence customer adoption, retention, revenue, operational efficiency, and long-term business value.

• Demonstrated experience hiring, developing, mentoring, and managing senior product professionals and high-performing product teams.

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Design, or a related field preferred. MBA or advanced technical degree is a plus.

Experience in cryptocurrency, digital assets, derivatives, financial services, fintech, payments, brokerage, trading, banking, or other technology-driven financial businesses is a plus, but it is not required.

We are also interested in candidates from SaaS, technology, enterprise software, e-commerce, marketplaces, financial technology, and other organizations with complex digital products.

Location and Work Arrangement

This position is based in the United States. The company offers remote, hybrid, and on-site working arrangements depending on the individual, location, and business needs.

Travel may be required as needed for leadership meetings, product planning sessions, customer research, partner discussions, team meetings, conferences, and industry events.

Compensation and Benefits

The company offers a competitive executive compensation package, including:

• Competitive executive base salary
• Annual performance-based incentive
• Equity appreciation opportunities
• 401(k) retirement benefits
• Medical, dental, and vision insurance
• Paid time off and company holidays
• Professional development and industry training
• Reimbursement for approved business travel

Final compensation will depend on experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role.

jobs.title: Vice President of Product Operations
jobs.description:
Company Description
The Global Fintech Network is a society dedicated to making fintech accessible to a broad and diverse audience. Its mission is to connect students, early-career professionals, and fintech enthusiasts across the globe through shared learning and collaboration. The organization focuses on building a supportive community where members can exchange ideas, gain insights, and grow their careers in financial technology. The Global Fintech Network believes that a better future is possible when passionate people from around the world work together on innovative solutions.
Role Description
The Vice President of Product Operations is a full-time, remote role responsible for overseeing the end-to-end effectiveness of product delivery and performance across the organization. This role will lead product operations strategy, establish processes and frameworks, and coordinate cross-functional initiatives to ensure products are aligned with the needs of students, professionals, and fintech enthusiasts. Day-to-day responsibilities include partnering with product managers to optimize roadmaps, managing programs and projects that improve product quality and scalability, and using data to drive operational improvements. The Vice President will also collaborate with leadership to define success metrics, streamline workflows, and support a culture of continuous improvement and transparency.
Qualifications

Strong Product Operations experience, including building and optimizing processes that support scalable product delivery and performance.
Demonstrated expertise in Product Management, with a track record of collaborating with cross-functional teams to define product vision, strategy, and roadmaps.
Proficiency in Program Management and Project Management, including planning, execution, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
Advanced Analytical Skills, with the ability to interpret data, define metrics, and translate insights into actionable operational improvements.
Experience in fintech or technology-driven organizations, with an understanding of digital products and user-centric design principles.
Strong leadership and people management capabilities, including mentoring teams, fostering collaboration, and driving alignment across functions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly to diverse audiences.
Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, technology, or a related field; advanced degree or equivalent experience is beneficial.
